key_concepts: Vertebrates are animals with a backbone
The backbone is made of small bones called vertebrae
The backbone protects the spinal cord
Vertebrates have an internal skeleton and a skull protecting the brain
Some vertebrates are ectothermic or cold-blooded
Some vertebrates are endothermic or warm-blooded
Vertebrates are classified into fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals
Fish live in water, have fins and scales, breathe with gills, and are cold-blooded
Amphibians begin life in water with gills and later develop lungs and legs for land
Reptiles are cold-blooded, have dry scales, lay eggs on land, and breathe with lungs
Birds are warm-blooded, have feathers and wings, and lay eggs
